name: Flame-Broiled Grilled Chicken Breast on Soft Brioche
whyItWorks: Flame-broiled marinated chicken breast served on a soft plain bun provides clean, lean protein without batter, grease, or heavy cheese, making it one of DCA's most reliable dining choices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the chicken sandwich plain with no sauce. Skip the toppings bar (lettuce, tomato, raw onions, pickles) and choose sliced apples instead of waffle fries.
